# Zarya Style

> Zarya Style is Pakistan's online destination for premium everyday and occasion wear — authentic, quality stitched and unstitched clothing featuring the latest trends for men and women.

Zarya Style offers curated collections across Western Fashion, Pakistani Fashion, Top & Jeans, and Maxi categories. Orders are delivered nationwide across Pakistan, with standard delivery costing Rs. 200 (free on orders of Rs. 3,000 or more) and typical delivery time of 4-6 days.

## Store

- [Shop](https://zaryastyle.com/shop): Full product catalog with filters by category, size, color, and price.
- [About Us](https://zaryastyle.com/about-us): Brand story, mission, and values.
- [Contact Us](https://zaryastyle.com/contact-us): Customer support contact form and details.
